name: gads
description: Google Ads API (account list, GAQL search and gated mutations), plus advertising and publisher APIs: Search Ads 360, Display & Video 360, Campaign Manager, Ad Exchange, AdSense, AdMob, Real-time Bidding and more.

allow_writes.title: Allow write tools
allow_writes.description: Modifying and deleting tools are listed only when this is on, and every change still asks first unless confirmation is off.

confirmation.title: Confirm before changes
confirmation.description: every-change asks before any change or delete (recommended). destructive-only asks only before deleting or sending. off asks for nothing; deny rules still apply. Change it here at any time.

token_dir.title: Token directory (optional)
token_dir.description: Where OAuth tokens are stored. Leave empty for ~/.google-services-mcps.

ads_developer_token.title: Google Ads developer token
ads_developer_token.description: Issued by Google Ads for your manager account. Stored in the system credential store, not in a file. Leave empty to use the token-directory file instead.

ads_login_customer_id.title: Manager (login) customer ID (optional)
ads_login_customer_id.description: 10-digit ID of the manager account, without dashes, when you reach client accounts through one.
